extracted.intended_audience: Heads of Executive Departments and Establishments; agency management and personnel/HR officials; OMB/Executive Office staff
extracted.subtask_description: Transmittal memorandum rescinding specified portions of OMB Circular No. A-64 and directing agencies to follow relevant provisions of OMB Circular No. A-11 for derivation, issuance, monitoring, and reporting of full-time equivalent (FTE) employment ceilings. Also clarifies that A-64 position-management provisions remain effective.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supersession of A-64 employment-ceiling provisions by A-11
rubrics_metrics.description: The provisions of Circular No. A-64 pertaining to employment ceilings and Bulletin No. 83-5 are superseded by relevant portions of Circular No. A-11 (e.g., section 13 and Appendix D).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Effective with issuance of OMB Circular No. A-11, Transmittal Memorandum No. 54 (dated July 19, 1983), agencies must look to A-11 for instructions regarding employment ceilings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific portions of A-64 rescinded
rubrics_metrics.description: Specifically the following portions of Circular No. A-64 are rescinded: (a) References to employment ceilings in section 1 (Policy); (b) References to employment ceilings in section 2(c); (c) Sections 4, 5 and 6; and (d) Attachment C.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agencies should treat these enumerated parts of A-64 as no longer authoritative for employment-ceiling matters and instead follow the cited parts of A-11.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consolidation of instructions on derivation, issuance, monitoring, and reporting of FTE ceilings in A-11
rubrics_metrics.description: With the issuance of OMB Circular No. A-11, all instructions regarding the derivation, issuance, monitoring and reporting of full-time equivalent (FTE) employment ceilings are contained in that Circular.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operational processes and reporting related to FTE ceilings (derivation, issuance, monitoring, reporting) must be aligned to the procedures and schedules set out in A-11 (see section 13 and Appendix D as examples).

rubrics_metrics.name: Retention of A-64 position management systems provisions
rubrics_metrics.description: The portions of OMB Circular No. A-64 that pertain to position management systems remain in effect.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Although A-64's employment-ceiling provisions are rescinded as specified, agencies should continue to follow A-64 for position-management system requirements until further notice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effective date and authority for change
rubrics_metrics.description: This memorandum notifies agencies that, effective with the issuance of OMB Circular No. A-11, Transmittal Memorandum No. 54, dated July 19, 1983, the cited provisions are superseded.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agencies should treat the issuance date of A-11/Transmittal Memorandum No. 54 as the operative date for transitioning responsibilities from A-64 to A-11.

rubrics_metrics.name: Background rationale for consolidation
rubrics_metrics.description: OMB Circular No. A-64 (Revised) and Bulletin No. 83-5 previously addressed employment ceilings; the Assistant Secretaries for Management Group suggested consolidating all Executive Office of the President instructions related to development, implementation, or revision of employment ceilings into a single instruction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agencies should understand the consolidation aims to centralize policy and procedures for consistency; when implementing changes, follow consolidated guidance in A-11 rather than disparate earlier documents.
